New · Full-stack ● BACKEND IN PRODUCTION

MedCare Doctor booking · 2 roles

A two-role medical appointment platform — patients find a doctor and book in the clinic's time zone, doctors run their day from a live dashboard. I built both sides: the Flutter client and the Node.js/TypeScript + PostgreSQL API behind it.

170+Test files
500KRows load-tested
27Backend stages
50+Reusable widgets
  • Two roles, one appPatients search by name, specialty or clinic, then book, reschedule or cancel; records, prescriptions, notifications. Doctors confirm, decline or complete visits, set weekly hours and time off, write records.
  • Booking that survives bad networksIdempotency key on retries, duplicate-tap blocking, and clear handling when a slot was just taken (409) or a status change isn't allowed.
  • Auth that holds up under load6-digit OTP reset, secure token storage, one Dio interceptor that shares a single refresh across concurrent 401s, and a 429 Retry-After lock.
  • Production backend, built in 27 stagesNode.js/TypeScript REST on PostgreSQL + Prisma; every stage gated by lint, type-check, tests and build. A partial unique index makes double-booking impossible; ownership-based access control.
  • Pagination that scalesKeyset on createdAt + id, HMAC-signed opaque cursors, 20 per page (100 max), a frozen response envelope — load-tested on 500,000 rows. Pull-to-refresh and load-more retry on the client.
  • Polished and provenArabic/English RTL with translated server error codes, design-system tokens, skeletons, Lottie and staggered motion that respects reduce-motion. 170+ test files plus opt-in integration tests against the live API.

New · Backend API NODE.JS · MONGODB · REDIS

UNSAID Anonymous messaging API

The REST backend for an NGL-style anonymous messaging app — 60 endpoints across auth, user and message modules. The receiver can ask who sent a message; only if the sender accepts does a private two-person conversation open. Until then, the sender's ID never leaves the database.

60Endpoints
171End-to-end checks
15 minAccess-token life
30 daysAccount restore
  • Request-to-reveal identityThe receiver asks who sent a message; the sender accepts or rejects. Accepting opens a private conversation linked to the original message that only the two participants can read or write.
  • Brute-force lockout with RedisFive failed logins lock the account for 5 minutes using Redis counters that expire on their own. The API returns attempts left and a Retry-After countdown, and emails a security alert.
  • 2-step verification & hashed OTPsEmail 2-step at login. OTPs are stored as HMAC hashes bound to a purpose (verify, reset, restore, 2-step), with a 5-try limit, a 60-second resend cooldown and one-time atomic use.
  • Rotating refresh tokens15-minute access tokens and rotating 7-day refresh tokens tracked per device, with reuse detection, logout from one or all devices, and sessions revoked on password change.
  • Moderation & privacyBlock users — even anonymous senders, without revealing them — report messages, accept or refuse guest messages, publish a message with a public reply, and soft-delete with a 30-day restore.
  • Hardened, then provenRedis rate limiting, idempotency keys and versioned caching; Multer uploads checked by file signature; helmet, credentialed CORS, stable error codes. Fixed inherited bugs — a sender leak in the inbox, exposed password hashes, 41-day tokens — and verified it all with 171 end-to-end checks against real MongoDB and Redis.

Siratic صراطك · Quran & Azkar

A complete Islamic companion — Quran, Tafsir, Hadith, Azkar, Sebha, Quran radio & reciters, prayer times and Athan — published on Google Play and shipped through multiple versioned releases. Its newest feature listens while you recite and follows your reading word by word.

6,236Verses · offline Tafsir
3.8×Corpus compression
10 msLargest record render
114Surahs
  • Live Quran recitation trackingListens while you recite and reveals your reading word by word in real time — start from any verse, resume, retry a verse, auto-advance.
  • Arabic speech, solved in productionPartial results, repeated words, word matching and the microphone session lifecycle, with Provider + Selector keeping rebuilds and battery use low.
  • Offline Tafsir Ibn KathirAll 6,236 verses: an 85 MiB Arabic corpus packed into a 26 MiB SQLite asset with per-row zlib (3.8×), decompressed lazily — the largest record renders in 10 ms.
  • A pipeline with integrity gatesPython HuggingFace → Parquet → SQLite with key-completeness, schema and index checks and byte-for-byte round-trip validation against a corpus-wide SHA-256; versioned with PRAGMA user_version.
  • Tap any ayah on a justified pageTouch offsets mapped through RenderParagraph.getPositionForOffset, keeping one continuous RTL RichText layout instead of splitting it per verse.
  • Athan that actually ringsScheduled local notifications with flutter_local_notifications — no Firebase or push — and a fixed Android 13 Do Not Disturb bug, verified on physical devices.

4UI states handled
OfflineLast weather cached
0Blank screens
MVVMCubit + Clean Arch
